title: SUSE Linux security advisory (AV26-1053)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1053 Date: October 15, 2026 As of October 15, 2026, SUSE is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Rancher Prior to 2.10.5 Prior to 2.11.1 Prior to 2.9.9 Steve Prior to 0.2.1 Prior to 0.3.3 Prior to 0.4.4 Prior to 0.5.13 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Users who can create Projects can gain access to arbitrary projects Steve doesn’t verify a server’s certificate and is susceptible to man-in-the-middle (MitM) attacks SUSE Update Advisories Article Link: SUSE Linux security advisory (AV26-1053) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
